## Fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

Both families are distributed under the SIL OFL 1.1, which allows bundling, subsetting and commercial use.
The files in `assets/fonts/` are subsets (only the glyphs the game's text uses) made with `tools/subset_fonts.py`
from the npm packages below; the full licence texts are next to them.

| file | family | source package | licence text |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NotoSerifSC-400.woff`, `NotoSerifSC-600.woff` | Noto Serif SC (Google / Adobe) | `@fontsource/noto-serif-sc` 5.3.1 — https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk | `assets/fonts/OFL-NotoSerifSC.txt` |
| `Cormorant-500.woff`, `Cormorant-500i.woff`, `Cormorant-600.woff` | Cormorant Garamond (Christian Thalmann, Catharsis Fonts) | `@fontsource/cormorant-garamond` 5.3.0 — https://github.com/CatharsisFonts/Cormorant | `assets/fonts/OFL-CormorantGaramond.txt` |

| library | licence | use |

## Everything else

Geometry (rock, buildings, the stele, the rider and horse, props), ornament patterns, clouds, particles,
all sound effects, ambience and music are generated by the code in this repository at bake time or at run time.
No sampled audio, no third-party models, and no generated (paid or free) AI assets are included.
The reference image in `ref/` is used only for measurement and comparison; it is never loaded by the game.
